key_insight: Tile-level linear probing closely tracks slide-level performance, making it a fast proxy for comparing histopathology foundation models.
clinical_relevance: This could speed up model selection for digital pathology workflows by narrowing candidates before costly whole-slide evaluation.
method: Measured correlation between tile probing and slide-level results using ABMIL and Mean Pooling
evidence_signal: Across the evaluated tasks, tile and slide performance showed high correlation, and tile benchmarks reliably shortlisted top-performing models.
watch_item: Tile-level screening is useful for narrowing models, but final validation on the target clinical slide-level task is still necessary before deployment.
paper_title: From Patches to Patients: A study of the tile-to-slide performance transferability in Digital Pathology
